name: list-subscriptions
description: Lists Stripe subscriptions by status (active, past_due, canceled, trialing and the rest, or all), optionally for one customer id from stripe__find-customer, with each one's billing period, prices and quantities. A subscription's customer id feeds stripe__get-customer. When hasMore is true, nextCursor passed back as cursor reads the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of subscriptions to return.

customer.description: Optional Stripe customer ID, such as one returned by stripe__find-customer.

status.description: Subscription status to return. Use all to include canceled subscriptions.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of an earlier answer with the same filters, to read the subscriptions after it.
